english: Thank you (stūtiyi; the everyday spoken form)
Sorry / Excuse me (samāwenna; to apologize or get attention)
It's okay / No problem (kamak nǣ; also means 'you're welcome')
Please / Kindly (pin sidda wenna; warm, polite way of asking a favor)
Excuse me / May I (awasara; asking permission to pass or leave)
I forgot (maṭa amataka wuṇā; polite acknowledgement)
